creative_direction: Create a sculptural pomegranate made from porcelain, split open to reveal glossy ruby-glazed seeds. The outer shell is warm white with delicate crackle lines, and a small matte gold stem curls above the crown. Set the fruit on a pale celadon surface against a deeper celadon background, keeping the composition centered and compact. Render the seed clusters as distinct rounded forms with varied red translucency, while the shell remains softly matte. A few chips along the cut edge reveal the ceramic thickness without making the object damaged or dirty. Use one gentle side light and a controlled shadow. No plate, cutlery, writing, or additional fruit.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
